newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada says will change bond pricing practice.
newsitem.headline: Canada says will change bond pricing practice.

text.p: The Government of Canada said on Thursday it will change the way it prices some of its bonds.

"Beginning with the first issue in 1997, the Government of Canada will be adopting the practice, used by market participants, to price bonds where the settlement date is less than a standard six full months from the first coupon date (i.e. a bond with a "short" first coupon)," it said in a statement released with its quarterly bond auction schedule.
The government said investors should contact Kevin Fettig (416-681-2405) at the Bank of Canada for more details.
